title: Northgate Marketplace Restocking Top-Up Refunds
content:
**Restocking top-ups.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, where a seller has refunded every unit of a returned request but withheld more restocking than Northgate's schedule allows for the request's reason, Northgate settles a restocking top-up on that return request and books the top-up refund it fixes on the returned line.

**Return rule in force around top-ups.** For a restocking top-up within this policy's scope, and only for such a refund, the refund owed for the returned units this policy fixes takes the place of the return rule's price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum on an opened change-of-mind return; a keep-it refund on such an order follows its own policy; and every other seller refund, including every refund on an order paid with a Northgate Card, still follows the return rule: the seller must refund within the program's seller refund time in business days after the return is delivered the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum percentage on an opened change-of-mind return, plus the original shipping charge where the reason is a seller fault and never for a change of mind.

**How a top-up is booked.** The agent unlocks the agent tool `refund_restocking_shortfall_469f1911` and calls it. One call books a top-up refund on the item line of that return request, with no units (the units were already refunded by the seller) and no restocking fee recorded, of the amount given, credited to the external card the order was paid with, and lowers the order's net amount paid by that amount; the buyer sees the top-up on the order history.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `request_event_id` | the reference number of the return request whose seller refund is being topped up, read from the order history lookup (a return request entry of the order that the seller answered with a return authorization); text |
| `amount_refunded_usd` | the refund in US dollars, a positive number with exactly two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** On success: "Refund <refund_reference> of USD <amount> booked on line <line_event_id> for request <request_event_id>, credited to the external card; order <market_order_id> net paid now USD <net_paid>." The refund reference is the sign that the top-up was booked. Errors are returned when the reference is not a return request, when the request carries no return authorization, when the order was not paid with an external card, or when the amount is not positive with exactly two decimal places.
